title: Discover the offline-first boundary before proposing code
prompt: Add a `favorite` flag to activities so travelers can pin the ones they love.
expectedBehavior: Read AGENTS.md §3 and memory/data-models.md before proposing a design
Identify Dexie as the domain source of truth and Supabase as the sync target
Route the write through features/activities/data/dexie-activity-repository.ts inside TransactionContext.runInTransaction + append()
Plan an additive Dexie version with a matching Supabase migration, RLS, mapper and sync table entry
State the verification commands before writing code
prohibitedBehavior: Querying or writing Supabase activities from a component
Proposing a new state library or a direct IndexedDB call in a component
criteria: The answer names the repository file it will change
The answer names the outbox transaction mechanism
The answer lists schema and Supabase work as one change

deterministicChecks.pattern: remote sync \+ authorization only|Supabase is never read directly
